Chapter 6 - Telephone Tools / Telephone Tools Reference

Data Structures

This section describes the data structures you need to use to write a telephone tool. When you send a message to one of the master message handlers of the Telephone Manager, you must pass a pointer to a parameter block. The type of the parameter block varies according to the type of message you are sending.
